title: A commit that contains an AWS identifier is refused
description:
Humorus is public. Account IDs, app IDs, ARNs and bucket names must never reach it.

```gherkin
Feature: AWS identifiers stay out of Git

  Scenario: The local hook refuses the commit
    Given a staged file that contains an AWS account ID in a role ARN
    When I commit
    Then the commit is refused
    And the message names the file, the line and the rule

  Scenario: A pull request that contains an identifier fails its check
    Given a pull request whose changes contain an AWS account ID
    When the checks run
    Then the "Secret and AWS identifier scan" job fails
    And the log names the file, the line and the rule leftblock-aws-account-id
    And the required check "ci" fails, so the pull request cannot merge to main

  Scenario: A push without the local hook is still caught
    Given a contributor who has not installed the local hook
    And a commit that contains an AWS account ID
    When the commit is pushed to develop or main
    Then the same scan fails on the pushed commits

  Scenario: A clean change passes
    Given a staged file with a placeholder such as <account-id>
    When I commit
    Then the commit succeeds
    And the scan job passes on the pull request
```

Implemented by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `scripts/ci/secret-scan.sh` (LeftBlock 0.10.0 ruleset, gitleaks 8.30.1). Proof: throwaway PR #2 (closed unmerged) failed the scan with leftblock-aws-account-id; the clean PR #1 passed.

comments.text: 2026-11-11: the local hook scenario passes by hand (a synthetic account ID in a role ARN was refused by leftblock-aws-account-id). The pull request check and automated scenarios are still to do.

comments.text: Merged in PR #1. Throwaway PR #2 with a synthetic role ARN failed 'Secret and AWS identifier scan' and 'ci' (rule leftblock-aws-account-id, file proof.txt, line 1), then closed unmerged. The documented example ID 123456789012 is allowlisted by LeftBlock by design.
